tools.name: get_blueprint_summary
tools.description: Reads the current blueprint settings, runtime versions, and a paginated summary of configured steps. Use before adding structural steps that reference existing pages or when checking what is currently in the builder.

page.description: Page number for paginated step results, starting at 1.

page_size.description: Maximum steps to return per page (1 to 12, defaults to 12).

tools.name: configure_blueprint
tools.description: Updates the blueprint site title, PHP version, WordPress version, or default landing view. Use when setting site metadata or runtime environment versions.

site_title.description: WordPress site title displayed in the builder and applied as blogname.

php_version.description: Target PHP runtime version for the WordPress Playground.

landing_page_type.description: Initial view opened when the Playground launches.

custom_landing_url.description: Relative WordPress path (e.g. /about) used when landing_page_type is custom.

tools.name: add_blueprint_steps
tools.description: Appends one or more configured setup steps to the blueprint in order and selects the last added step. Use when building a site with pages, posts, media, plugins, themes, menus, homepage settings, or a guided tour.

steps.description: Ordered list of WordPress setup steps to append to the blueprint.

type.description: Kind of WordPress setup step to append.

config.description: Step fields matching the type (e.g. postTitle, slug or url, pageTitle, menuName, menuItems, tourMode).
